title: Stronglad
safeHtml:
Stronglad is one of the Sub-Districts of Asylum. It is located at the Central South Area of Asylum, and its District Code is 29-10.

Contents

  • 2 Future Development

    • 3.1 Public Housing

History[]

There has been two possible sources regarding the name of Exalt Gardens. One of them has to do with paying homage to Winky Wong, a former member of the Hong Kong-based Beanies, and the other was the fact that an expedition team headed for Coopol passed by this area and saw many strong lads.

Stronglad was previously divided into Stronglad West and Stronglad East. While Stronglad West became Stronglad, Stronglad East became Hawynveil.

Despite being one of the areas with a significant public housing presence, this District also houses the second largest Private Housing Project in Asylum in the name of Wonder Central. Wonder Central Phase 1 features a Shopping Mall, and is one of the few Housing Estates with its own Interior Shopping Mall. With a size smaller than only Seaside Broadwalk, Wonder Central features a total of 4808 flats, with each flat featuring triple rooms.

Future Development[]

The West Side of Stronglad will be majorly developed in conjunction with Snowty, and had therefore seen possibility of increasing housing. However, the type of housing that will be built is unknown.

Summer Point Gateway is a gateway on Akashi Line, Southern Corridor and Southern Corridor Rapid. It is jointly operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division) and Nawis Railway, and is located at Los Sengas Twenty-Second Continent. For Nazca Railway, this station will serve Vision Line, Greensleeves Line and Echo Line in the future.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Solaris Conflux.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Confluence of the Inner Lands".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Solaris Conflux 02:58
Golden Axis 03:59

Station Characteristics[]

  • This station is one of the Group 2 Gateways of Nazca Railway, and is located at approximately 20 km to the southwest of Metropolis Terminal.[3]
  • This station is the permanent upbound terminus of Akashi Line.
  • This station broke the record of Sand Martin Checkpoint, Apple Hill Station and Fall Point Gateway as the station with the third most number of platforms at 16 platforms, behind Metropolis Terminal and Centopia. However, only 12 of the 16 platforms are used by Nazca Railway.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Akashi Line platforms of this station are Bay Platforms.
  • The in-station transit of this station is a circular line that runs only in the clockwise direction. The order of the stations are East Concourse Station, West Concourse Station and Shops Station. In fact, this is the first instance of a circular in-station transit in Nazca Railway.
  • All Group 2 Gateways make use of a shape at the sides of its walls. This Station uses Quadrilaterals.

Future Development[]

  • According to the Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline, this station will become the permanent upbound terminus of Vision Line that already interchanges with Akashi Line at Diamond Pool Station in the other end.
  • According to the Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition, Greensleeves Line and Echo Line will connect to this station.

History[]

  • October 17 2021: This station began services alongside Akashi Line. Akashi Line completed development, and other platforms in this station remain reserved.
  • March 8 2023: Nawis Railway Southern Corridor and Southern Corridor Rapid extended to this station from Moonbeam Heights and Le Monde respectively.
  • April 28 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]

Description[]

Sun-Bufly Line is a line connecting Nazca Ferry Pointdown Ferry Terminal with Nazca Railway Bufly Island Station. This line is represented by the red color, and currently has three stations.

Districts Served[]

  • West Metropolis Archipelago
    • Bufly Island
    • Sunrise Island

Fun Facts[]

  • This line is named after the fact that it ran between Sunrise Island and Bufly Island. However, following the regeneration of Sunrise Island at the beginning of Season 3, the Sunrise Island Section of this line has been demolished. Currently, this line only runs within Bufly Island.
  • When this line was complete, this line had 5 stations, with three at Bufly Island (Pointdown Station, East Bufly Station, West Bufly Station) and two at Sunrise Island (Sunrise South Station and Sunrise North Station). However, following the regeneration of Sunrise Island at the beginning of Season 3, the two stations at Sunrise Island has been demolished, leaving this line with only three stations.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after the fact that large amounts of sunflowers can be seen at the original biome of the area.[2]
  • Special Seats are seen at the Los Sengas Coffee in this station.
  • A large-scaled village development took place near this station.
  • As Sunflowers look at the sun, and Solar Powers also need to face towards the sun, Solar Panels are constructed near this station.[3]

History[]

Sungo Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. This isle is located within the cape of Sunrise Island. Despite being located within close proximity to Sunrise Island, this isle has not seen any development, as this island, together with Sunin Isle, are both protected.

Sunin Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago. This isle is located within the cape of Sunrise Island. Despite being located within close proximity to Sunrise Island, this isle has not seen any development, as this island, together with Sungo Isle, are both protected.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Black and White Color scheme of this station not only alludes to the whiteness that can be seen briefly before sunrise at the sky, but also the Minecraft Name of the Island Owner as well. Moreover, this station is also one of the few stations in which a gray color scheme is used, as Black and White can be combined to create gray.[2]
  • The Platforms of this station are 304m long.
  • The Boarding position of Platforms 1 and 2 deviates slightly from the center point of the Platform in order to divert passenger flow.[3]
  • Exit B was already reserved for future use at the time of this station's construction.

History[]

  • November 30 2018: This Station began services.
  • August 27 2020: The Stadow Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[4]At the same day, Exit B is added to this station.[5]
  • March 21 2022: This station completed exit naming.[6]

Description[]

Swift Line is the second branch line of NR Los Sengas Division Luxter Line. It passes through Youngsters, Sava and Downtown.

This route is represented by Dark Green Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 7B.

Currently, this route is 11.39 km long, with a total of 10 stations.

History[]

  • S3E13P2: Coast Edge - Vayler
  • S4E2: Coast Edge - Mayler Airport 2

Districts Served[]

  • Youngsters
  • Sava
    • Polibiomes
    • Threeler
  • Downtown

Line Charcteristics[]

  • One of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • This line is the second branch line of Luxter Line.
  • At the time of its completion, this line was the longest branch line in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division at 10.66km long. However, this record was later broken in S3E14P1 by Sava Line, another Luxter Line Branch Line when it extended to Peacean Island Station and became 16.17km long.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Extraordinary Virtuoso.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Extraordinary Virtuoso 03:34

Fun Facts[]

  • This station, as well as the Island on which this station is located, is named after a senior in an orientation camp in which the railway builder participated in [2]. While she requested for a dim green color in the station when this station was built, as the building materials does not have that color available, lime wool had to be used for compensation. However, the actual color (livery) of the station could be done as requested.
  • This station features the first irregularly shaped concourse in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.

History[]

  • September 11 2015: This station began services.
  • August 8 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • June 18 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[4]
  • July 16 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.
  • August 28 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[5]

Description []

Tachyon Line will be one of the District lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It will serve Teraleros and Paloros.

This route will be represented by Light Blue on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and will be Line Number 33.

Tai Hing Road is a divided roadway located in Los Sengas Peckern North. It stretches from Purplaetus at the south, branches out to the east in the name of Tai Lok Street at Tai Hing Estate, and connects to Tai Hing Road Extension as it continues to Bondhill Curves.

Tai Hing Elevated is an elevated roadway locating above Tai Hing Road, and it spans from Gampton Estate, passing above Shek Pai Tau East Roundabout, through Leung Tin Elevated as an interchange, providing an exit to Tsit Kok Street, and ends in direct connection to Sai Toi Shan Road towards Pak Sheung Street.

As a physical boundary dividing two major development areas of Dansein and Tin Kum-Shek Pai Tau New Town, Tai Hing Road kept layering more structures over time. It also witnessed the long history of development in the two areas, spanning over generations of developers, and the entirety of the Tin-Shek New Town redevelopment.

History[]

Tai Hing Road was constructed and opened as a four-lane dual carriageway at the east fringe of the Shek Pai Tau New Town, very soon after the Town was founded. Developers of the adjacent Dansein Residential Area flattened the land east of the road immediately after, in reserve for expansion of future housing developments. This results in Tai Hing Road diving up the two development areas as a major arterial, showing a difference in development styles and progresses on both sides of the road. Following south the road connects to Purplaetus and other areas of Peckern, while the north curves perpendicularly to Constellation Circuit (Tai Lok Street in present) at the east.

Later when the same developers at Dansein took over Shek Pai Tau and rebranded as Tin Shek New Town, reconstructions began at the Shek Pai Tau side to unify the building styles. Large-scale expansion and projects were also done on Tai Hing Road, including turning a signal-controlled intersection into a semi-spiral roundabout, constructing Tai Hing Elevated and SLT tracks, etc. However because of land constraints, the structures on Tai Hing Road became more and more complex than before, with sections containing 5 layers of roadway and railway strcutres.

In spite of relocating Tai Hing Estate to the north, and the development of Dansein North Residential area, Tai Hing Road was extended northward in a separate name as Tai Hing Road Extension to Southouse Centre (the extension was renamed Nottingham Road past Fai Ming Estate). Meanwhile during the construction of Po Tin Street Interim Housing, the curve and the segment to the east were reconstructed as a semi-spiral roundabout with adjustments to the roadway volume, and later renamed as Tai Lok Street.

Current Status[]

Tai Hing Road currently carries traffic coming from Dansein Market and Dansein North, with its elevated overpasses, underground railway tracks, sandwiching SLT tracks, and bus stops on both sides. The spatially-constrained roadway passes through the Uk Hip region, and evolves into ramps with Route 12 on the way to Purplaetus, as one of the main arterials supporting the urbanized region of Peckern North.

Tai Nung Plains Station is a station on West Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Twenty-Second Continent. Passengers may also use this station to change to Sexterade LRT Pak Kei Line (Tai Nung Plains Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • The design of this station pays tribute to Key Lake Station in Terracept Division.
  • The name of this station alludes to Sheung Che Nung Station.
  • This station is the completion station of West Ring Line. As a result, a completion memorial is set up at this station.

History[]

  • September 29 2015: This station began services. West Ring Line completed construction.
  • August 25 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • February 26 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Tai Nung Plains Stop is a stop of Pak Kei Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT, and is located at Los Sengas Twenty-Second Continent. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nazca Railway West Ring Line (Tai Nung Plains Station).

Tai Wan Peninsula Station is a station on Minecraft Line and Charlie Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas TriPaw. Passengers may also use this station to change to Phantasia Metro OasisPaw Line, Oasis Express (Tai Wan Peninsula Station) and Element Hub Transit Evillow Line, Evillow Express (Tai Wan Peninsula Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this station alludes to Taiwan. As a result, the lime and blue terracotta of this station alludes to the two main political parties in Taiwan at the time, namely the Democratic Progressive Party and Kuomintang.[5]
  • The Station Banners of this Station are set up to the South of the Station above the tunnel entrance of Minecraft Line and Charlie Line tracks.

History[]

  • September 11 2016: This station began services. Minecraft Line and Charlie Line are established.
  • July 24 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[6]
  • March 11 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • November 14 2024: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[7]
  • April 18 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[8]

Tat Stone Hill Checkpoint is a checkpoint on Urban Line, Urban Express, Oasis Bay Line and Echo Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Jupiter. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nawis Railway Snow White Line (Tat Stone Hill Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is one of the three planned "super-checkpoints" of Nazca Railway in Season 3, with the second being Sand Martin Checkpoint, and while the third was not explicitly mentioned, it was implied to be Winter Point Gateway.
  • This station is the first station to undergo expansion in 2019.
  • While this station was meant to be one single large Checkpoint, but due to changes in plans, this Checkpoint was split into two different checkpoints, with the second checkpoint being Europa Checkpoint.
  • The name of this station alludes to one of the players in Project Nazca who uses "TAT" very often to express disappointment and whose name alludes to "Diamond", which in turn could allude to Diamond Hill Station and Tat Chee Avenue. The Color scheme of this station also alludes to his favorite color.[2]
  • The concourses of this station form a letter "T", and the exterior of this station resembles the letter "A". As a result, the Urban Express Platforms are narrower than that of Urban Line Platforms.
  • The original Station Number of Urban Line for this station is 04-3X, with X indicating the service of Urban Express, but due to the completion of Seraphynx Station, it is modified to 05-3X.

History[]

  • September 26 2018: This Station began construction.
  • September 29 2018: This Station began services alongside Urban Line and Urban Express.
  • February 20 2019: This Station began and completed expansion of the West Oasis Bay Line and Echo Line part.
  • February 21 2019: West Oasis Bay Line extends from Dumbbell Plateau Station to this station. Echo Line is established.
  • December 22 2019: Oasis Bay Line merges with West Oasis Bay Line.
  • June 13 2020: This station had been sabotaged.[3]
  • July 23 2020: The Urban Line section of this station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[4]
  • November 23 2022: Exit K is added to this station to the Nawis Railway Station of the Same Name.[5]
  • March 28 2024: Epsilon Line is renamed Echo Line.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station has the first In-Station Transit System that consists of more than two stations (there are 6 of them in in total).
  • The Concourse North and Concourse South Stations of Tenbal Island In-Station Transit do not have direct access with each other.
  • Passengers have to make use of the Tenbal Island In-Station Transit to reach the Exits of this station.
  • In Total, the Tenbal Island In-Station Transit have six stations as follows:
    • Tenbal Island Exit D Station
    • Tenbal Island Exit C Station
    • Tenbal Island Exit B Station
    • Tenbal Island Concourse North Station
    • Tenbal Island Concourse South Station
    • Tenbal Island Exit A Station
  • This Station is the first Underground Station to be completely built under the seabed.
  • The Tenbal Island In-Station Transit Stations on Tenbal Island are not accessible with each other. Passengers boarding the In-Station Transit at Exits B, C, D would head either directly to the concourse or to the Exit A Station.
  • Exit A of this station is an artificial island that provides a Station Park and five different piers.
  • The Concourse of this station does NOT feature entry gates as the entry gates are all located at the exits.
  • A section of the underwater tunnel of the Tenbal Island In-Station Transit reaches a depth of Y=2, making this section of tracks the deepest tracks in Nazca Railway. The record of the deepest tracks in Los Sengas would not be surpassed until the completion of Kirameki Electric Railway Citybranch Line Tye Island Station at Y=1.

  • November 30 2019: This Station began construction.[3]
  • December 2 2019: This Station began services.
